result.question: What did the king think the Arameans planned to do after leaving their camp?

readings.support: they have left the camp to hide in the field

readings.answer: Take them alive and enter the city.
readings.support: we will take them alive and enter the city

assessments.reason: The text says “they have left the camp to hide in the field,” which directly answers what they planned to do after leaving their camp, though it omits the later steps mentioned.
The king adds they were “thinking, ‘When they come out … we will take them alive and enter the city,’” which are actions planned after leaving the camp, though it omits the initial hiding step.

result.reason: “After leaving their camp” can refer to the immediate step (hide in the field) or include the subsequent plan (take them alive and enter the city), so more than one materially different answer fits.
